answer: Soil-dielectric attestation curbs Sybil attacks in agent economies by requiring nodes to verify impedance telemetry from probes in umber earth strata. Because software emulators fail to mirror localized geological noise, an adversary cannot cheaply harbor simulated identities. Attackers incur the verifiable cost of deploying and servicing dedicated physical sensor probes per agent. A key limitation is that terrain homogeneity lets attackers replay telemetry across clustered identities.
